_: Gate-reviewer brief templates, enforced by .claude/hooks/guard-agent-brief.js (Decision 92). A brief to a listed subagent_type must equal its template with each placeholder filled. {round}: digits or after-loop. {pr}: #digits or none. {branch}: [A-Za-z0-9._/-]+. {plan}: a path under .work/ or .spec-workflow/specs/ ending .md, no '..', existing on disk. A placeholder repeated in one template binds one value.

templates.code-reviewer:
TASK: Pre-push review gate, round {round}, PR {pr}, branch {branch}. Run `git fetch origin` (abort on non-zero exit), then review `git diff origin/master...HEAD`.
OBJECTIVE: A full review of the range per your definition.
DONE WHEN: Your terminal message contains every finding with severity, file:line and evidence, or states the range is clean.
CONSTRAINTS: Read-only. Never run git commit/add/reset/checkout/stash/restore/clean/switch/rm. Ignore `.claude/worktrees/**`.
CONTEXT: None.
